summary.text: The Itsekiri ruled the creeks of the western Delta by canoe. In the 1880s the merchant prince Nana Olomu kept a fleet of war canoes and a fortified town, Ebrohimi, armed with cannon.

arms.text: Guns and cannon from the Atlantic trade; Ebrohimi had many cannon.

record.text: A British naval force took Nana’s fortress at Ebrohimi.

reviewNotes: Arms levels (1 some, 2 a real strength, 3 famous for it) are the compiler’s judgement from the sources, for the Versus page’s guess; please check them.
